name: Pocket FDE incident triage

nodes.input: Library incident facts or custom issue; hidden evaluation answers excluded

nodes.rule: Analysis requires v1, v2 or v3; unknown version permits source inspection only

nodes.corpus: Same approved cards, reviewed notes, world definitions and customer guides

nodes.rule: Recognized customer identifiers redacted before the provider request
Connected model; bounded router; one repair maximum

checks: At least three usable diagnostic questions

nodes.rule: Private immutable analysis snapshot scoped to the browser workspace; browser draft restoration

Successful analysis automatically drafts provisional learning in private shared storage without another model call; human approves or rejects; only approved learning joins both retrieval modes. Optional manual entry remains available.

hosted_controls.session: Encrypted HttpOnly Secure cookie, eight-hour expiry

limits: No proven real-world or collaboration gain
Citation identity checks do not establish factual entailment
